body.p: This paper is in response to the Restriction Requirement, mailed July 3, 2024 in which the Examiner has required restriction between the following patentably distinct species and subspecies:
Species A: Figs. 4 and 6; Coating layer with through orifice

Subspecies 1: Figure 4, Retention device utilizing fixing means attached to framework and bolt attached to coating layer; Subspecies 2: Figure 6, Retention device utilizing bolt attached to framework.
Species B: Fig. 5; Coating layer without through orifice.

Applicant hereby elects, without traverse, Species A and Subspecies 2, Fig. 6. As indicated above, claim 9 has been withdrawn. Applicant reserves the right to rejoin these claims or file a divisional application which contains these claims.
In view of the foregoing, it is believed that the present application is in condition for substantive examination.
The Commissioner is hereby authorized to charge any additional fees which may be required to this application under 37 C.F.R. §§ 1.16-1.17, or credit any overpayment, to Deposit Account No. 07-2069.
Should the Examiner discover there are remaining issues which may be resolved by a telephone interview, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned attorney at (312) 987-2927.
By /PATRICK J. SMITH/ Patrick J. Smith Registration No. 65,626
